'''Feather''' is a young [[wolf]] who is the mate of [[Leafhunter]] and part of her pack.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Feather}}

==Activities==
After [[Perrin Aybara]] has a dream and cannot idendify a scent, he reaches out to Feather and the rest of the pack. Feather leaves the link when he recognizes the scent, that of the [[Darkhound]]s.{{ref/book|10|5}}
